task_spec.name: Personal Portfolio Website
task_spec.original_requirements: Create a responsive personal portfolio website with About, Projects, and Contact sections.

features.description: The website must be structured as a personal portfolio.
acceptance_criteria: The main page must load and display the About section.
The main page must display the Projects section.
The main page must display the Contact section.

features.description: Displays information about the individual owner of the portfolio.
acceptance_criteria: The About section must contain descriptive text about the person.

features.description: Showcases various personal or professional projects.
acceptance_criteria: The Projects section must list multiple individual projects.
Each listed project must include a title and description.

features.description: Provides methods for visitors to get in touch with the owner.
acceptance_criteria: The Contact section must contain at least one visible contact method (e.g., form, email link).

task_spec.description: A responsive personal portfolio website featuring dedicated sections for About, Projects, and Contact.

requirement_traceability.rationale: The user explicitly requested a portfolio website with 'About, Projects, and Contact sections.'

sources.quote: Create a responsive personal portfolio website with About, Projects, and Contact sections.

requirement_traceability.rationale: The user explicitly requested the 'About' section.
The user explicitly requested the 'Projects' section.
The user explicitly requested the 'Contact' section.
The user specified the website must be 'responsive'. This is treated as a nonfunctional requirement.

sources.quote: Create a responsive personal portfolio website

constraint_traceability.rationale: The framework default runtime is single_html, which is suitable for a simple portfolio website.

missing_information.description: Specific content required for the sections.
missing_information.question: What specific text, images, or data points should be included in the About section, Projects section (e.g., number of projects, project details), and Contact section?
